text: /^(compress|fade|merge|rewrite|remove|archive|shorten|change|改写|降一级|挪进档案|压缩|合并|删|缩短|淡)/
why: Recognises the verb a stage wrote in a change's op. It already accepts the English verbs (compress, merge, rewrite, …); the Chinese ones stay so that what a stage in the reference pack writes is still read.
